audit_items.proof_trace: The function has an unconditional early return at L93-95: `if (self.total_supply == 0) { return float::from_quotient(1, 1) }`, which returns the initial exchange rate (1.0) before any division occurs. The denominator `float::from(self.total_supply)` on L98 is only reached when `total_supply > 0`, making divide-by-zero unreachable. Multiple tests (L372, L403, L415, L788, L801) confirm the 1:1 initial rate.
